integrity: Derivation and finite exact-rational checks conducted for this claim; generic quasiconvex optimization and source Nash identities are acknowledged prior results. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires primitive layers with a common strictly positive stationary distribution; private opinions bounded to [0,1]; quadratic game; the cardinality frontier is for an explicit cost-contrast family. No conclusions for layers that change centralities or other distortion metrics.
title: Quasiconvex minimax attention and a sharp layer-count law in strategic multiplex consensus
